concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-method-revoke-node]] - limited-release Node.js revocation of a payment-method grant, deleting the granted version from the receiving merchant's Vault without importing the separate payment-method deletion cascade
warnings: Keep the Grant API's current limited-release status and access-request requirement prominent; do not present revocation as generally available.

Describe the effect exactly as deletion of the granted payment-method version from the receiving merchant's Vault; do not broaden it to the granting merchant's original payment method or generic account access.
Do not import subscription cancellation, paid-day forfeiture, transaction effects, or other cascades from the separate paymentMethod.delete operation.
Do not infer success semantics or response fields from the callback's err and result parameter names.
